entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 76, signed by 𝔓76, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Gospel of John. The surviving texts of John are verses 4:9,12. Papyrus 76 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
